note: Literature establishes a recurring association between TBC1D32 mutations and pituitary stalk interruption syndrome (PSIS) within the syndromic hypopituitarism spectrum.

evidence.text: Recessive variants in TBC1D32 are associated with congenital hypopituitarism phenotypes including polydactyly, neuroimaging abnormalities, and pituitary stalk interruption syndrome.
